title: bupleurum graminifolium var. globosum
intro: Bupleurum graminifolium var. globosum, commonly known as Globe Hare's Ear, is a plant species within the genus Bupleurum, which belongs to the family Apiaceae. Globe Hare's Ear is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, such as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Globe Hare's Ear include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit hepatoprotective effects, and act as a neuroprotective agent. The bioactive constituents of Globe Hare's Ear include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
